parties: Robust Hotels Limited; Arun Kumar Saraf
headline: Arun Kumar Saraf Discloses Substantial Acquisition in Robust Hotels Limited
sum: Arun Kumar Saraf filed a Regulation 10(5) disclosure under SEBI's takeover code, signalling a substantial acquisition or change in shareholding in Robust Hotels Limited (NSE: RHL). The specific acquisition details, shareholding percentage and consideration remain undisclosed in the publicly available headline.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosures are trigger events for mandatory open offer obligations under SEBI's takeover regime; the acquirer's identity and timing confirm substantive M&A activity but the shareholding quantum and price discovery will depend on the full disclosure document.
detail: Arun Kumar Saraf submitted a Regulation 10(5) disclosure to NSE on 24 June 2026 in relation to Robust Hotels Limited. Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 mandates disclosure when a person acquires, in aggregate, 25% or more of the voting capital of a company, or when an acquirer increases their holding to cross the 25% threshold. The filing indicates a material corporate event but the full disclosure document (available via the NSE archive link) contains the precise shareholding figures, consideration, and conditions precedent.
